blocks.heading: Military Healthcare AI (BAMC Ecosystem)
paragraphs: Brooke Army Medical Center (Fort Sam Houston) is the US military's flagship medical center and a world-leading trauma and burn care institution:

Trauma outcome prediction (commercial AI): ML for injury severity prediction, resuscitation outcome, and ICU resource utilization for BAMC's Level I trauma program — incorporating combat casualty care patterns that inform civilian trauma AI with injury types and treatment protocols specific to military trauma.

Burn center analytics: ML for burn wound area estimation, fluid resuscitation need prediction, and outcome forecasting for BAMC's Burn Center — the US military's primary burn care facility and one of the world's leading burn care programs.
Rehabilitation analytics: ML for functional recovery prediction and rehabilitation therapy optimization for BAMC's large traumatic brain injury and amputee rehabilitation programs.
ClickMasters builds commercial AI for non-classified civilian translation research; HIPAA-compliant where applicable.
Cost: $60,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | Military privacy requirements

blocks.heading: University Health System AI
paragraphs: University Health System (San Antonio's public hospital, serving Bexar County's uninsured and Medicaid population, academic affiliation with UT Health San Antonio):

Safety net population health: ML for University Health's large Medicaid and charity care patient population — social determinants of health integration, population risk stratification, and chronic disease management for San Antonio's complex urban safety-net population.

Spanish-English bilingual clinical AI: Clinical decision support and patient navigation AI in Spanish and English for University Health's large Spanish-speaking patient community — 65% of San Antonio's population is Hispanic, and University Health serves a predominantly Spanish-speaking patient base.
Texas Medicaid STAR program analytics: Population health ML for University Health's Medicaid managed care programs under Texas HHSC's STAR program requirements.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA, Texas HHSC, Spanish

blocks.heading: Baptist Health System and Methodist Healthcare
paragraphs: Baptist Health System (San Antonio, 5-hospital system) and Methodist Healthcare (San Antonio, HCA Healthcare's largest Texas market outside Houston):

Clinical deterioration prediction: Sepsis early warning and clinical deterioration prediction for San Antonio's community hospital networks — Epic-integrated for Baptist and Meditech-integrated for Methodist's HCA facilities.

Prior authorization automation: PA automation for San Antonio's commercial payers (BCBS of Texas, UnitedHealth, Aetna Texas) and Texas Medicaid for Baptist's and Methodist's high-volume hospital operations.
Revenue cycle optimization: Coding accuracy, denial prediction, and billing optimization ML for San Antonio's large hospital revenue cycle operations.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA

blocks.heading: Health Sciences and Research
paragraphs: UT Health San Antonio (University of Texas Health Science Center), the South Texas Veterans Health Care System, and the research programs adjacent to BAMC:

Clinical research cohort identification: NLP and ML for UT Health's IRB-approved clinical research programs — identifying eligible patients from EHR data for oncology, diabetes, and cardiovascular research.

Veterans health analytics: ML for the South Texas VA Health Care System's large veteran patient population — PTSD, traumatic brain injury, and military-related health condition prediction and management.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA + VA data governance

blocks.heading: Texas Medical Practice Act
paragraphs: Clinical AI in Texas must align with Texas Medical Practice Act regulations governing clinical decision support and physician practice.

blocks.heading: Texas HHSC and Medicaid
paragraphs: San Antonio's large Medicaid patient population creates HHSC analytics and reporting AI demand for the managed care organizations and safety-net hospitals serving Bexar County's Medicaid community.

blocks.heading: Military health privacy
paragraphs: BAMC-related clinical AI may involve military health records that are subject to specific privacy protections beyond HIPAA — ClickMasters designs military healthcare AI with awareness of both HIPAA and military-specific health privacy requirements.
